program.address_context: Original unrelocated file-backed EE PT_LOAD; M17 synthesized rows.

provenance.source: Authenticated Japanese ELF; rows decoded by the private M15 R5900 decoder.
limitations: Original-instruction versus C equivalence is a separate differential (tools/verify_lifecycle_differential.py).
The text column is an analysis aid; bytes are authoritative.

functions.name: main_0011d830
functions.interpretation: hg_main_init (0011d830..0011d934) and hg_main_frame (loop body 0011d938..0011d9fc): engine initialization calls, initial mode 001432c0(00121810), the two 0011dfd0 waits, EE timer setup, then per frame 0095e308 = 0, the render/engine services, the mode dispatcher 00143240, the vblank wait on 0095e308, 00149890/001496e0 and [gp+2f84] += 1.

functions.name: mode_dispatch_00143240
functions.interpretation: hg_mode_dispatch: points 700000c0 at the mode block gp+2dc0, promotes state 1/4 to 2 and calls the handler at +4 for state 1, 2 or 4.

functions.name: mode_init_001432c0
functions.interpretation: hg_mode_init: writes handler, state 1 and clears +8..+27 of gp+2dc0 directly.

functions.name: mode_set_00143300
functions.interpretation: hg_mode_set: the same through the 700000c0 pointer.

functions.name: gameplay_mode_0012d1c0
functions.interpretation: hg_gameplay_mode: 700000c4 = 2, the float accumulator gp+2f7c (+1.0, reset above 100000.0), the main-loop frame tick gp+2f80 += 1, then the major state 0..5 (enter, title/menu, reload, new game, continue, play).

functions.name: gameplay_major5_0012d9a0
functions.interpretation: hg_gameplay_major5: minor 0 entry, 1 play 0012e700, 2 0012f270, 3 003372a0, 4 teardown 0012f800, 5 area load 0012dd60, 6 reload.

functions.name: area_pack_id_0012dbd0
functions.interpretation: hg_area_pack_id: PACK directory for the area triple 003fa1b0/b1/b2 from the tables gp-7e00/gp-7df0.

functions.name: area_load_step_0012dd60
functions.interpretation: hg_area_load_step (minor 5): render reset, player block clear, AREA request 00130150(1, table[area]), PACK request 00130150(2|3, 0012dbd0), fades and the per-frame camera/player/area setup until the destination is ready.

functions.name: gameplay_frame_0012e700
functions.interpretation: hg_gameplay_frame (minor 1): sub 0 entry setup, sub 1 active frame (coordinator 0012f850/0012f950, event flags 0012fa00), sub 2 pause menu (resume, title, teardown), sub 3/4 menu and timed states, sub 5 warp to the destination triple 0046d92c, sub 6 restart in area 1 with preserved fields.
